response.rationale: Immunosuppressed patient with acute sinusitis, orbital and intracranial extension on imaging strongly favors invasive fungal sinusitis over metastatic disease or inflammatory/autoimmune conditions.

rejected.why: Tolosa-Hunt is idiopathic orbital inflammation, less consistent with bilateral sinus opacification and immunosuppression.
Cancer history is a risk factor but imaging pattern and acute presentation favor infection over metastasis.
GPA typically shows more destructive sinus changes and systemic vasculitis, not acute invasive pattern in an immunosuppressed host.
